doc_friction.issue: Suggests `python3 platform/ci/run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes` for a small docs/story diff; it ran dozens of unrelated actions-*-check workflows (it seems to treat the whole tree as changed), costing several minutes for a text-only change.

Hearth & Horizon BIBLE 'Done' lines are scattered under 'Next up' and 'What not to do' rather than in one list, so finding where a new Done line goes and whether a topic is taken means grepping 270+ story front matters.

deviations.why: Audio cap exceeded (423 MB > 400 MB), so the story landed text only, as the prompt directs.
deviations.did: text, pages, feeds, llms.txt, post; no MP3

notes: Project hearth-and-horizon, piece the-last-dark-noon (Pluto, sub-Charon station, 2237; noon eclipse season, a last eclipse that is not total). Chosen because the science fiction shelf is the headline project and no Pluto/Charon story existed. Numbers from a scratch script: Charon 3.77 deg at zenith, 96 min central eclipse, 0.037 deg/Pluto day drift, ~103 eclipses, last totals 41/37/32/26/18 min, 103 a 12.6 min partial with ~6% uncovered; every weekday checked in code (28 May 2235 Thu, 30 Jan 2237 Mon, 11 Feb Sat, 3 Mar Fri, 9 Mar 2237 Thu; Easter 2237 = 2 Apr, so 9 Mar is in Lent week 3, corrected from a first-draft 'second week'). Adversarial pass also fixed a heater rationale that made no thermal sense at 1.5 W/m2 and a 16,000 km limb distance (18,400). Verification: node --test in ventures/hearth-and-horizon 12/12 pass; run_workflow_locally --for-changes run in the background (see PR).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
